name: experience-architecture
description: Find out why a web app's navigation, pages, links or Back button feel wrong, decide whether its structure should change, and prove it in a real browser. Diagnose, Rethink and Verify over a zero-dependency toolkit for route maps, browser journeys, prototypes and URL migrations, plus Walkthrough (preview), which learns the product by using it, says what it should become and can carry the improvement through. Strongest on React and Next.js.
